g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the 30-minute reward before an opt-in game, declining leaves reading unchanged, and the proposal gives a path for an ad failure.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes without sponsored stories, not cash or something exchangeable outside the app.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger uses an article-open counter and a return to the home feed, not chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The adds and decline fields leave existing reading, saving, and sharing available; the proposal does not cap a free feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a banner on the content-safe s01 home feed above the first story, not inside a conversation or next to unsafe content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product change, the temporary ad-free reward is tied to f01, the observed home-feed-to-article reading loop.

c2_evidence.reason: The what makes it work here and subscribers fields turn the absence of an observed home-feed paywall into claims that the app has no paywall and every reader is free. The rationale also calls the ads cheap or low-value, which the observed placements and variable fill do not establish.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward lasts 30 minutes and is capped at two offers per day, so it does not give away an unlimited subscription benefit.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger waits until the reader returns to the home feed after an article, rather than interrupting an article in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The if the ad fails field and flow grant the reward when the game closes, played or not; the reward must instead depend on a server-verified play.

c7_specific.reason: The placement and reward name the s01 home feed, its category pills and sponsored card, and sponsored cards in articles.
